title: Linear MCP Server
summary: Connect your agent to Linear's hosted MCP server to find, read, create and update issues and projects without leaving the terminal.
description: Linear provides an official remote MCP server for its workspace. The agent can look up an issue by key, read the thread, create follow-ups and move work between states.
Authentication is OAuth, started the first time you connect. Linear also serves a read-only endpoint if you only want the agent to look.
useWhen: Start work from an issue key and read its full context
File follow-up issues for the TODOs found in a change
Summarize what is in the current cycle
Update an issue status after a pull request merges

mcp.name: linear
access: Reads and writes issues, projects and comments you can access in Linear

example.prompt: Read ENG-482 and tell me what is left to do.
example.result: ENG-482 "Export invoices as CSV": the endpoint exists, the date filter and the download button are missing. Two comments ask for UTF-8 with a BOM.

faq.question: Can I make it read-only?
faq.answer: Yes. Use https://mcp.linear.app/mcp/readonly as the URL, which exposes only read tools.

faq.question: How do I sign in?
faq.answer: The first connection starts an OAuth flow. In Claude Code, run /mcp and pick Linear.

access: Reads and can change Linear issues you can access
